verdict.rationale: An official LangSmith MCP server is documented (probe-4), so users can operate LangSmith through natural language from an external AI client. Agent-readable docs (llms.txt, markdown pages) support that workflow. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language command interface: LangSmith Engine automatically detects and diagnoses issues but is not described as taking NL commands, and other operations run via the UI, API or SDKs. Missing for 10: an in-product natural-language command or assistant interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.
